name: Ann Demeulemeester

prices.note: US market /en-us (USD). Collections man-clothing-trousers, denim-men, denim-women; 31 available regular-price pants (blouson and longjohns excluded): Michael 5-Pockets High Comfort Trousers $635 to Gerry Lounge Pants $1,950; Agdar Pleated Carrot Pants $1,390, Vive 5-Pockets Straight Leg Trousers (women) $750. Descriptions say Made in Italy on all but one (Portugal).

notes: Shipping: USA $25 by DHL Express, free over $800 (full-price items); US is served DDP, so duties are included in the price; US customs may need an SSN or EIN (https://anndemeulemeester.com/en-us/pages/shipment-information).
Returns for refund within 14 days of delivery; US return shipping fee 50€; security tag must be intact (https://anndemeulemeester.com/en-us/pages/return-policy).

Company: AD Milano S.r.l., Via Savona 97, Milano (legal notice). About page: Ann Demeulemeester is a member of the Antwerp Six; Stefano Gallici creative director since 2023. Boutiques in Paris, Milan and Antwerp (no US store listed).
known_for from the homepage description: 'timeless elegance and avant-garde designs'.
